name: brink
description: Read and change your Brink notes and task lists, and arrange Brink's workspaces and tabs, through Brink's own MCP server.

token.title: Connection token
token.description: The brk_… token Brink showed when you added a connection for Claude Code. Claude Code keeps it in its secure storage.

edition.title: Brink edition
edition.description: Which copy of Brink to connect to: the App Store's Brink, or a Brink Dev build.

app.title: Brink app (optional)
app.description: Where Brink.app is, if Spotlight can't find it. Leave empty to find it by its bundle id.
